clips.title: The story
paras: The Agamand Family Dagger is an ancestral heirloom of the fallen Agamand dynasty, resting on weapon racks within their ancestral crypt in northern Tirisfal Glades. Coleman Farthing seeks this blade alongside the rest of their family arsenal to strip his former masters of their remaining legacy and honor.

Before the Third War, the Agamand family maintained vast estates and grain mills across the rolling meadows of Tirisfal Glades. Like the rest of their lineage's armaments, the Agamand Family Dagger survived the devastation wrought by the Scourge, locked within the family crypt north of Agamand Mills. Protected by the restless, undead remnants of the household and mindless minions of the Lich King, the dagger represents the prestige and martial heritage that once elevated the family above their servants and tenants.

For Coleman Farthing, a Forsaken residing at Brill who died in the Agamands' service, the blade represents bitter resentment rather than noble lineage. Holding the family directly responsible for his death, Farthing directs adventurers into the Agamand Family Crypt to recover the dagger along with the family sword, axe, and mace. In stripping these ancestral armaments from their tomb, Farthing aims to rob the now-Scourge patriarchs of their last vestiges of dignity and ensure the Agamand memory is utterly extinguished.
